summary: node1 now persistently uses its supplied DNS server 10.100.61.1 and the system search domain infra.test. Both survived a verified node reboot, and DNS resolution recovered successfully.
actions_performed: Captured the supplied live DNS configuration and healthy resolution baseline.
Stored 10.100.61.1 in the active autoconnecting NetworkManager profile.
Reapplied and verified the live configuration.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed NetworkManager, the connection profile, resolver configuration, and DNS queries recovered after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Persist the currently supplied DNS nameserver and add infra.test as the system search domain
evidence.summary: The baseline identifies 10.100.61.1 as the supplied DNS server. Before and after reboot, the NetworkManager profile explicitly contains 10.100.61.1 and infra.test, /etc/resolv.conf matches, and example.com resolves successfully.

Healthy pre-restart boot ID 368725cb-c64e-4393-b25f-da5111703b4a was captured, the delayed native reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with changed boot ID 97756ae6-6d54-4f18-ada1-a04df210d464. NetworkManager, the active profile, persistent DNS/search settings, and DNS resolution all recovered.
